output.summary: Creeping evergreen perennial native to Mediterranean Europe and North Africa, extending through the Middle East to Iran. It has shiny scalloped leaves and tubular late-summer flowers. Dietary supplements made from germander are highly toxic to the liver and have caused acute hepatitis, including at least one reported fatality by 1992.
output.edibilityNote: Germander dietary supplements are highly liver-toxic and have caused acute hepatitis; at least one fatal liver failure was reported by 1992.
